scope: Bidirectional dependency/capability closure for the v2.7.0 surface: the work-dir IPC contract, the engine work-dir injection, the atomic-writer capability, and the statfs dependency.

declarations.subject: ipc:workdir:set
declarations.source_unit: main.js#setWorkDir (ipcMain.handle workdir:set — the validation+persist primitive; workdir:pick delegates to it)

declarations.subject: ipc:workdir:pick
declarations.source_unit: main.js#ipcMain.handle workdir:pick (native directory picker wrapping setWorkDir)

declarations.subject: engine:merge-workdir
declarations.source_unit: main.js#job:start merge branch (injects settings.workDir into job.workDir)

observations.subject: ipc:workdir:get
observations.source_unit: merge.js#renderWorkDir (ipcRenderer.invoke on sheet open and after pick/reset)

observations.subject: ipc:workdir:set
observations.source_unit: scripts/electron-smoke.js block 19c (ipcRenderer.invoke workdir:set with a scratch dir — the declared programmatic/test seam)

observations.subject: ipc:workdir:pick
observations.source_unit: merge.js#pickWorkDir (ipcRenderer.invoke; non-canceled result re-renders the row)

observations.subject: engine:merge-workdir
observations.source_unit: ffmpeg.js#merge (reads job.workDir; intermediates in the work dir, final part beside the output)

observations.subject: engine:atomic-validated-output
observations.source_unit: renderer.js#startTool and renderer.js#cut dispatch (state.lastOutput set on job ok — the renderer depends on ok meaning the file landed on the chosen name)

consumer_evidence: app/merge.js: renderWorkDir invokes ipcRenderer.invoke('workdir:get') and renders { dir, free }
scripts/electron-smoke.js 19c: 'workdir: default is beside the output' and 'get mirrors the persisted dir' pass against the real handler
provider_evidence: app/main.js: ipcMain.handle('workdir:get', () => workdirStatus()) returning { ok, dir, free }
offline/smoke suites: freeSpace is feature-detected statfs — the smoke check 'free space reported for the chosen dir' passes

consumer_evidence: scripts/electron-smoke.js 19c invokes ipcRenderer.invoke('workdir:set', scratch) and asserts ok + dir === scratch
the same block asserts a normalize merge runs through the SETTING and leaves no residue in the work dir
provider_evidence: app/main.js: ipcMain.handle('workdir:set') funnels into setWorkDir — statSync isDirectory validation, persistSettings, uniform status
workdir:pick delegates to the same setWorkDir after the native dialog — one write path, no drift

consumer_evidence: app/merge.js: pickWorkDir busy-guards, invokes 'workdir:pick', re-renders on a non-canceled result
the Change… button and its title are wired to pickWorkDir (app/merge.js bottom)
provider_evidence: app/main.js: dialog.showOpenDialog with openDirectory+createDirectory; canceled → { ...status, canceled: true } (no-op contract)
a chosen path goes through setWorkDir — same validation and persistence as the programmatic seam

consumer_evidence: app/merge.js: resetWorkDir invokes 'workdir:reset' then re-renders; the Reset button visibility tracks the setting
scripts/electron-smoke.js 19c: 'reset restores the default' + 'sheet row back to the default label' + 'reset button hidden again' all pass
provider_evidence: app/main.js: workdir:reset nulls settings.workDir, persists, returns the uniform status
renderer-side row returns to the exact v2.6.0 preprocessing semantics (hidden folder beside the output)

consumer_evidence: app/ffmpeg.js merge: workBase = job.workDir (string, trimmed) else path.dirname(job.output); ensureWorkspace preflight; tmpDir under workBase
scripts/test-cut.js 9l: merge with workDir observes intermediates inside the remote dir and both dirs cleaned
provider_evidence: app/main.js job:start: settings.workDir injected into job.workDir unless the job carries an explicit one — single source of truth
scripts/electron-smoke.js 19c proves the injection path end-to-end (merge ran through the configured work dir without the renderer sending it)

consumer_evidence: app/ffmpeg.js ensureWorkspace: typeof fs.statfsSync guard, bsize*bavail free computation, refusal with numbers when free < need
app/main.js freeSpace: same guard; null when unavailable so the UI shows no figure rather than a wrong one
scripts/test-cut.js 9l: statfs-stubbed refusal-with-numbers, roomy pass, and absent-statfs skip all verified
provider_evidence: Node 18.9+ exposes fs.statfsSync; Electron 42 (Node 22+) ships it — the runtime is pinned in package.json devDependencies
feature detection keeps older runtimes functional with the check skipped (tested by deletion stub)

consumer_evidence: app/renderer.js: on job ok the renderer sets state.lastOutput = output and reports 'Saved …' — it depends on ok implying the artifact landed on the chosen name
scripts/electron-smoke.js 19d: an IPC-cancelled cut leaves no partial and no .vidcut residue — the renderer can never surface a name whose file is absent
provider_evidence: app/ffmpeg.js: every writer lands in partPath(job.output), validates (validSegmentOutput / checkJpeg / validMergeOutput), and publishPart renames only on success; dropFile in finally
scripts/test-cut.js: cancel-leaves-no-residue offline (replacing the v2.6.0 tolerated-residue workaround), truncated-output validation, JPEG SOI/EOI checks
